title: The Chicken and the Egg
thesis: EM is a two-step loop (E: guess soft labels; M: fit as if true; repeat) that provably never lowers the likelihood and recovers populations never observed separately.
the_bind: If you knew the labels, estimating the parameters would be trivial.
If you knew the parameters, guessing the labels would be trivial.
the_resolution: Bootstrap: guess one, fit the other as if true, re-guess, repeat.
